antibody.title: PD-L1 / atezolizumab Fab interface
antibody.assembly: Deposited biological assembly 1: label chains A/B/C, auth chains A/K/F, identity operation.
antibody.interfaceCriterion: Any interchain non-hydrogen atom distance <= 4.5 angstrom. Residues are identified by native author numbering.
antibody.chargedPairCriterion: Opposite-charge side-chain atom proximity <= 4.0 angstrom: Asp OD1/OD2 or Glu OE1/OE2 against Lys NZ or Arg NE/NH1/NH2. Histidine and termini are excluded because their protonation was not assigned.
antibody.caution: These are coordinate-based candidate ionic contacts, not measured interaction energies or proof of favorable net binding. A residue-charge or screened-Coulomb surface is an approximate model, not an APBS/Poisson-Boltzmann calculation. Keep surface labels consistent with the actual implementation.

ribosome.title: Mammalian UAG termination complex: E/P tRNAs and A-site eRF1

siteEvidence.P: The substrate stops after Val68 of human Sec61beta (Extended Data Fig. 1 and Fig. 5). The deposited Val tRNA is TA/auth2; Fig. 1 assigns the peptidyl tRNA to the P site.
siteEvidence.E: The other deposited tRNA is Lys, UA/auth3; the primary structure overview identifies the two occupied tRNA sites as P and E, while eRF1 occupies A.
siteEvidence.A: The paper's Fig. 1 and RCSB entry identify HC/authii eRF1 at the A site. It carries GG-to-AA substitutions in the GGQ motif and is correctly described as eRF1(AAQ).

ribosome.contextNote: fullContext retains every deposited atom except separately rendered eRF1 HC, P-tRNA TA, E-tRNA UA and mRNA GC. Context plus those four full component files is an exact disjoint partition of all 226454 source atoms. Backbone and CA/P trace are optional reduced representations; use fullContext for a transparent global view preserving all other components.

nativeGeometryCheck.reference: Deposited coordinates; author numbering. Geometric distances, not assigned covalent bond lengths.

fullContext.includes: All other deposited atoms, including every other polymer chain, nascent peptide, ABCE1, magnesium, zinc, ADP and iron-sulfur clusters. No ATOM/HETATM filtering.
